# Draft:Dataq Software

----
Dataq Software is a software development and IT services company headquartered in India. Founded in 2018, the company offers custom software solutions, web and mobile application development, and digital transformation services to clients across various industries including finance, healthcare, retail, and education.
History
Dataq Software was established in 2018 by a group of software engineers with a vision to deliver innovative and scalable digital solutions to businesses of all sizes. The company started as a small development firm and has grown into a full-service IT company serving clients both in India and internationally.
Services
Dataq Software provides a wide range of services including:
* Web Development – Custom websites and web applications using modern frameworks.
* Mobile App Development – Native and cross-platform apps for Android and iOS.
* Software Development – Enterprise software solutions tailored to client needs.
* Product Design – UI/UX design, prototyping, and product strategy.
* Digital Marketing – SEO, PPC, content marketing, and social media management.
* Cybersecurity & Support – IT security, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Online Training & Staff Augmentation – IT skill development and remote team services.
Notable Projects
Dataq Software has delivered software and mobile solutions for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises in India and abroad. The company has also worked on internal tools and AI-based products.
Key People
* Thiru Dasari, Founder and CEO
Locations
The company operates from its headquarters in Address Hyderabad Telangana, with remote teams and partnerships in other regions.
Recognition
The company has been featured in industry articles and tech portals for its innovative development practices and client-centric solutions.
